description: This file defines an enumeration `LaunchdManager` that manages launchd services on macOS, providing methods to start and stop the OpenClaw application via launchctl commands.

classes.name: LaunchdManager
classes.description: A utility enum for managing launchd services related to the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Private static helper method that executes the launchctl command with specified arguments.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Public static method to start the OpenClaw application by kickingstart launchd service.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Public static method to stop the OpenClaw application via launchctl.
